اضطبنوا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَبَنُوا (iḍṭabanū) /idˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اُضْطُبِنُوا (uḍṭubinū) /udˤ.tˤu.bi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اِضْطَبِنُوا (iḍṭabinū) /idˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
